message:
v2.2.0

Minor: two non-breaking additions bundled together (each alone would be at most a
patch/minor -- neither can fail an existing compliant workload):

- matchConditions fix (issue 08): replaces the broken matchConstraints.objectSelector
  version self-scoping with per-policy matchConditions CEL, evaluated inside Kyverno
  instead of flattened onto the shared ValidatingWebhookConfiguration. Zero verdict
  impact by construction -- same admission behaviour, correct mechanism. Required for
  genuine multi-version coexistence (single-version deployments never surfaced the bug).
- New cloud-plane policies (issue 17): require-s3-bucket-encryption (Deny gate, NIST
  sc-28) and require-rds-multi-az (Audit lane-keeper, NIST cp-10), targeting Crossplane
  v2's namespaced AWS provider-family CRDs. New policies cannot fail an existing
  compliant workload.

Also ships in this release (non-policy content, doesn't affect version semantics):
advisory metadata schema + editorial review process (issue 22), the policy handbook
generator with agent-authored plain-language summaries (issues 25/26), and the
demo-removal structural-deletion proof (issue 22).

require-department-label, require-known-department-label, require-owner-annotation
re-versioned alongside (a policy version covers the whole body); no verdict-affecting
content change to any of the three from v2.1.1.
